entries.title: Luke 18:1
segments: He also taught them by a parable how they ought always to pray and never to lose heart.

entries.title: Luke 18:2
segments: "There was a certain town," he said, "a judge who had neither reverence for God, nor respect for man.

entries.title: Luke 18:3
segments: "In that same town there was a widow who came again and again before him, saying, "`Do for me the justice of my adversary.'

entries.title: Luke 18:4
segments: "For a while he would not, but afterwards he said to himself, `Though I have neither reverence for God nor regard for man,

entries.title: Luke 18:5
segments: "`yet because this woman annoys me I will give her justice, lest by her continual coming she wear me out.'

entries.title: Luke 18:6
segments: "Listen" said the Lord, "to what this unjust judge says.

entries.title: Luke 18:7
segments: "And will not God see justice done to his elect who are crying unto him day and night, even if he seems to delay helping them?

entries.title: Luke 18:8
segments: "I tell you that he will quickly see justice done to his elect! Nevertheless, when the Son of man comes, will he find faith upon the earth?"

entries.title: Luke 18:9
segments: Moreover he spoke this parable to some who trusted in themselves because they were righteous, and looked down upon the rest:

entries.title: Luke 18:10
segments: "Two men are going up to the temple to pray; the one a Pharisee, the other a tax-gatherer.

entries.title: Luke 18:11
segments: "The Pharisee stood apart and thus began to pray by himself: "`O God, I thank thee that I am not like the rest of men, extortioners, rogues, adulterers, or even like this tax gatherer;

entries.title: Luke 18:12
segments: "`I fast twice a week, I pay tithes of all my possessions.'

entries.title: Luke 18:13
segments: "But the tax-gatherer, standing far back, would not lift up so much as his eyes to heaven, but kept beating his breast and saying, "`O God be merciful to me, the sinner!'

entries.title: Luke 18:14
segments: "I tell you that this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for every one who exalts himself shall be humbled; but he who humbles himself shall be exalted."

entries.title: Luke 18:15
segments: And they kept bringing their babies for him to touch them; but when his disciples saw it they began to rebuke them.

entries.title: Luke 18:16
segments: But Jesus called for the babies. "Let the little children come to me," he said, "do not hinder them; for of such is the kingdom of heaven.

entries.title: Luke 18:17
segments: "I tell you in solemn truth that whoever will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child, he will never get into it."

entries.title: Luke 18:18
segments: A ruler put this question to him: "Good teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?"

entries.title: Luke 18:19
segments: "Why are you calling me `good'?" said Jesus to him; "no one is good but God.

entries.title: Luke 18:20
segments: "You know the commandments: "Do not commit adultery, Do not murder, Do not steal, Do not bear false witness, Honor your father and mother."

entries.title: Luke 18:21
segments: "All of these," he replied, "I have kept from my youth up."

entries.title: Luke 18:22
segments: And receiving this reply, Jesus said to him: "One thing you are still lacking. Sell all that you have and give it to the poor, and you shall have treasure in heaven. Then come and follow me."

entries.title: Luke 18:23
segments: But when he heard these words he became deeply grieved, for he was exceedingly rich.

entries.title: Luke 18:24
segments: Jesus looked at him and said: "How hard it is for those who have money to enter into the kingdom of God!

entries.title: Luke 18:25
segments: Why, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for a rich man to enter into the kingdom of God."

entries.title: Luke 18:26
segments: "Who then can be saved?" exclaimed his hearers.

entries.title: Luke 18:27
segments: "Things that are impossible with men," he answered them, "are possible with God."

entries.title: Luke 18:28
segments: Then Peter said, "Look! we have left our homes and followed you."

entries.title: Luke 18:29
segments: And he said to them, "In Solemn truth I tell you that there is no one who, for the sake of the kingdom of God, has left houses, or wife, or brother, or parents, or children,

entries.title: Luke 18:30
segments: "who shall not certainly receive many times as much in this time, and in the age to come eternal."

entries.title: Luke 18:31
segments: Then he took the twelve aside and told them: "See, we are on our way to Jerusalem, and all prophets regarding the son of Man will be fulfilled.

entries.title: Luke 18:32
segments: "He will be betrayed to the Gentiles, and be mocked, and shamefully treated, and spit upon;

entries.title: Luke 18:33
segments: "and they will scourge and kill him; and the third day he will rise again."

entries.title: Luke 18:34
segments: But they understood none of these sayings. His words were a mystery to them, and they did not know what he meant.

entries.title: Luke 18:35
segments: As Jesus drew near to Jericho, there was a blind man who sat by the wayside begging.

entries.title: Luke 18:36
segments: He heard the crowd passing and asked what the matter was.

entries.title: Luke 18:37
segments: They told him, "Jesus of Nazareth is passing by."

entries.title: Luke 18:38
segments: Then he shouted out, saying, "Jesus, son of David, take pity on me!"

entries.title: Luke 18:39
segments: Those who went ahead began to reprove him and to tell him to be still; but he kept clamorously shouting all the more, "Son of David, take pity on me!"

entries.title: Luke 18:40
segments: So Jesus stopped and ordered him to be brought to him. When he was come near to him he asked him

entries.title: Luke 18:41
segments: "What do you want me to do for you?" "Lord," he answered, "that I might see again."

entries.title: Luke 18:42
segments: "Receive your sight," said Jesus, "your faith has saved you."

entries.title: Luke 18:43
segments: Instantly he regained his sight and followed Jesus, giving glory to God; and all the people who saw it gave praise to God.
